page_title: CHE 2-1 LIV | Chelsea v Liverpool 04/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+7' Holy smokes, you don't see that very often! Enzo Maresca gets a second yellow card and has to leave the bench.
90+5' 2 - 1 Goal! Marc Cucurella passes the ball to the feet of Estêvão (Chelsea), who has an empty net in front of him and has no problems in tapping the ball in. 2:1.
90+5' Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) sprays a pass out to Andrew Robertson, but he can't beat his man inside the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Chelsea.
90+4' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) pounces on a pass inside the box but flashes his shot just over the bar. That was a great chance!
90+3' Estêvão (Chelsea) threads a pass through to Enzo Fernandez, but Giorgi Mamardashvili breaks up the move.
90+1' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header only flies onto the left post and away off it.
90+1' The statistic for corner kicks – 7:2.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' Mohamed Salah plays the ball through to Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) on the edge of the box, he turns and shoots but it's a fraction wide of the left post.
90' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the left post is denied by a decent save from Giorgi Mamardashvili.
89' The resulting corner from Estêvão (Chelsea) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

89' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the underside of the crossbar is, however, superbly saved by Giorgi Mamardashvili! The referee signals a corner kick to Chelsea.
88' Romeo Lavia (Chelsea) sends a long through ball to Jamie Gittens, but he fails to control it properly and loses it to one of the defending players.
86' The substitution is prepared. Wataru Endo (Liverpool) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Alexis Mac Allister.
86' Estêvão (Chelsea) plays a lovely through ball to Marc Guiu, but he can't beat Giorgi Mamardashvili and loses the ball.
85' The linesman signals that Estêvão (Chelsea) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
84' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) took the corner.

84' Estêvão (Chelsea) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the left side of the goal, but Giorgi Mamardashvili thwarts him with a great two-handed save. Chelsea will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
84' Jamie Gittens (Chelsea) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Giorgi Mamardashvili has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
82' Referee Anthony Taylor halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Arne Slot, then shows him a yellow.

81' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
80' Estêvão (Chelsea) takes a short corner kick.

80' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. Now Chelsea have a corner.
79' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
78' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) picks out Mohamed Salah with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range. It's a throw-in for Liverpool.
77' Estêvão (Chelsea) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
76' Estêvão (Chelsea) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Chelsea force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
76' Estêvão (Chelsea) takes the corner with a short pass.
76' Marc Guiu (Chelsea) latches onto a cross into the box from the wing and gets in a header. It went well towards the goal, but it was blocked by one of the defenders.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pedro Neto departs the field of play to be replaced by Estêvão (Chelsea).
75' That will be all from Alejandro Garnacho who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Jamie Gittens (Chelsea).
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Joao Pedro trots off the pitch and is replaced by Marc Guiu (Chelsea).
74' Arne Slot has decided to make a change. Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) replaces Alexander Isak.
73' Alexander Isak (Liverpool) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
71' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) unleashes a first-time effort from long range, but it's blocked by the defender.
69' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
69' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
68' Problems for Enzo Maresca as Josh Acheampong is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Jorrel Hato (Chelsea) replaces him.
67' The game is interrupted now, Josh Acheampong (Chelsea) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
66' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
66' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea).
65' The total number of attempts is 5:6. Shots on target – 1:2.
63' 1 - 1 Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) receives a brilliant pass inside the box from Alexander Isak, and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the roof of the net. He makes it 1:1.
62' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) attempts to find Enzo Fernandez, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
60' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

59' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) wins some space for himself around the penalty spot and manages to produce a promising header. One of the defenders stops his effort before it gets to the goalkeeper, making him redundant. Good work from Chelsea as they win a corner.
58' Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
56' Substitution. Curtis Jones (Liverpool) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Ibrahima Konate walks off.
55' The referee signals a substitution. Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) is brought on as a substitute for Milos Kerkez.
55' Benoit Badiashile (Chelsea) is being substituted because of an injury. Enzo Maresca sends Romeo Lavia on the pitch.
53' Benoit Badiashile (Chelsea) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
53' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) tries his luck from the edge of the box, but it's one to forget and goes well wide of the left post.
53' Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
51' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) gets on the end of a pass and takes a low shot from the edge of the box which is straight at Robert Sanchez, who makes a comfortable save.
51' Handball by Malo Gusto (Chelsea).
50' The Liverpool players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
49' A crossfield pass from Robert Sanchez (Chelsea) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball has crossed the sideline. Liverpool are taking a throw-in.
46' CHANCE! Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) fires just wide of the right post from inside the box after running onto a splendid pass from Florian Wirtz.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Arne Slot gives a chance to Florian Wirtz and Conor Bradley (Liverpool) is off.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Reece James (Chelsea) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. Chelsea have a free kick.
45' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) trips an opposition player and Anthony Taylor signals a foul. Chelsea will take a free kick near the side line.
44' That was close! Alexander Isak (Liverpool) makes a good run into the centre of the box and gets his head onto a lofted pass, but sends the ball a fraction over the bar.
41' Robert Sanchez (Chelsea) plays a long ball to Alejandro Garnacho, but the defence is well organised and manages to get it clear.
41' Liverpool quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
40' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for Chelsea! Play can continue.
40' Enzo Maresca is stunned as referee Anthony Taylor shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
39' Referee Anthony Taylor makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Chelsea. Let’s see what happens!
39' Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
38' Some trickery by Marc Cucurella allows him to set up Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) on the edge of the box , and he blasts the ball at goal but it misses the right post by a whisker.
38' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) works the corner short.

38' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. Chelsea will take a corner kick.
37' Robert Sanchez (Chelsea) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball is out of play. Liverpool will have a throw-in.

35' Reece James (Chelsea) decides to speed play up by quickly sending the free kick into the box. Malo Gusto (Chelsea) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Pedro Neto, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
34' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Conor Bradley (Liverpool) was quite harsh and Anthony Taylor didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

34' A brilliant through ball from Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) as he picks out Milos Kerkez, who darted into free space to take the pass. Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
30' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) commits a rough challenge and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for an infringement. Free kick. Liverpool will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
28' Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.
27' Joao Pedro (Chelsea) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
26' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) sends a cross into the box, but Giorgi Mamardashvili comes off his line to gather the ball.

26' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared. Malo Gusto (Chelsea) picks up a rebound in space and tries his luck from long range, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
25' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle after Conor Bradley (Liverpool) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. A free kick has been awarded to Chelsea.
25' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) and Mohamed Salah try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move.
24' 59:41 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
19' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
19' What a great touch by Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) as he controls a fine pass into the box and fires the ball to the left post, but the effort is brilliantly blocked.
17' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) sends a cross in and finds Pedro Neto inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger.
16' Joao Pedro (Chelsea) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
15' 1:0 – the total goal attempt statistics.
14' 1 - 0 Goal! Malo Gusto slips it to Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) on the edge of the box and he finds the top left corner with a great effort. The score is 1:0.

13' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
12' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Alexander Isak. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.
10' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Giorgi Mamardashvili intercepts the ball.
8' A player from Liverpool commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
8' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) prepares to take a corner kick.
8' Milos Kerkez received a sweet pass from Cody Gakpo (Liverpool), but the advance is stopped. Liverpool force a corner. They send men into the box.
6' Benoit Badiashile (Chelsea) sends a long ball forward to Malo Gusto, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
4' Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
3' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) is penalised for a foul. Anthony Taylor had a clear view and blows his whistle.
2' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Giorgi Mamardashvili, who smothers the ball.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Liverpool will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Anthony Taylor.
